name: AI Nova - Ji Niang Yucheng Fangchengshi 2
source:
Experience living under the same roof with a robot girl!
Manage your time between adventuring and enhancing your android in this brand-new sequel!
Through a twist of fate, you managed to free Nova, an irregular android, from the authorities, and now you live together! Solve mysteries, get employed, and uncover the secrets behind her mysterious past!
translation:
体验与机器人女孩同住一个屋檐下的生活！
在这个全新的续集中管理你的冒险和增强你的机器人之间的时间！
命运的转折，你成功地将诺瓦（Nova），一个不规则的机器人，从当局手中解救出来，现在你们住在一起了！解开谜团，找到工作，揭开她神秘过去背后的秘密！
